product.title: Rome Vespa Tour with Professional Photographer

description.text: In Rome, capture your Roman holiday in style on this Vespa tour with an accompanying professional photographer. Drive by many notable landmarks, including the Colosseum and the Castel Sant'Angelo, for a comprehensive overview of the Eternal City. Stops include Colosseum, Castel Sant'Angelo, Piazza Venezia. Avoid the disappointment of taking sub-par vacation snaps—your driver–photographer–guide will take you to the most scenic spots, then take beautiful photos of you. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Colosseum, Castel Sant'Angelo, Piazza Venezia that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
